entries.en: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="ここよ、ここ！ あの人たちがライブをした店に自分がいるなんて！" t="Here! Right here! One of their shows, right here!" b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="ここよ、ここ！ あの人たちがライブをした店に自分がいるなんて！" t="Aici! Chiar aici! Unul dintre concertele lor, chiar aici!" b="" a=""/>

entries.en: Mmm, great. Can we go now?
<kiroshi l="jpn" o="もう、冷たいな" t="Ughhh, you are the woooorst." b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="もう、冷たいな" t="Ugh, ești cea mai nasoală." b="" a=""/>
entries.ro_m: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="もう、冷たいな" t="Ugh, ești cel mai nasol." b="" a=""/>

entries.en: Listen, been to a million shows. I love shows. Maybe if I was a few implants short I'd think this was nova.
entries.ro: Ascultă, am fost la o mie de concerte. Îmi plac concertele. Poate dacă mi-ar lipsi câteva implanturi, aș zice că e mișto.

entries.en: But I'm not, and I don't.
<kiroshi l="jpn" o="ジョニーが演ったのよ。〈Samurai〉と" t="Johnny played here. With Samurai." b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="ジョニーが演ったのよ。〈Samurai〉と" t="Johnny a cântat aici. Cu Samurai." b="" a=""/>
